summary: Constant-fold a function's length property when the exact function definition is statically known and the property was not redefined.

target.notes: Count parameters before the first default-valued parameter; rest is excluded; each destructuring pattern counts as one parameter.

semantics.count_rule: parameters before first default; rest excluded

caveats: Function length is configurable and can be redefined/deleted.
Bound functions compute a new length from target length and number of bound arguments.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Function Instances length
